# MambaOut

**Category:** CNN · **Code:**
[`timm/models/mambaout.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/mambaout.py) ·
**Architectures:** 11 · **Pretrained weights:** 12 (11 with ImageNet-1k results)

MambaOut stacks Gated CNN blocks, Mamba blocks without the state space model (SSM) token mixer, to test whether SSMs are
needed for image classification.

## Papers

* [MambaOut: Do We Really Need Mamba for Vision?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.07992)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('mambaout_tiny.in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```

✓ supported, ✓ (square) works for square sizes only, ✗ not supported, – not needed (the model already accepts any input
size). Checked by running each feature on a randomly initialized model (`MambaOut` with `mambaout_femto` at 224), other
architectures of the same class are expected to behave the same. See the [Model API](../model_api) page for details.
